notes.title: A new game is coming
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We are happy to inform you that finally, after a lot of hard work, Rattingham Studios will be announcing the next title later this week.

The next title, currently in development, will be directly connected to the narrative universe of Tower of Heresy, for which it was decided to make TOH free from the 30th of June to allow the community to play freely, and to show everyone the story prologue of the next title.


In conjunction with this announcement there will also be updates regarding Tower of Heresy, which will include: 

[list]
[*]a re-skin of the icons of weapons, item and some enemies

[*]various balances

[*]additions and rewriting of the descriptions of all the in-game items and equipement

[*]new HUD that shows the stamina bar

[*]new New Game+ that changes all game dialogues and events 
[/list]

We have worked hard with the new members of the Rattingham family to bring this new project to life, and we can't wait to show you and let you explore the world of Tower of Heresy from a new point of view.

Stay tuned for the new update and the announcement of the next title. May the Janas protect you!

notes.title: New Patch - Movement Change
notes.content:
We are happy to announce a major gameplay change that will improve your approach to the game.
New update that greatly improves the movement of the character.
From now on the character will have the movement in pixels and no more in squares, and for this some spells and weapons hitboxes have been fixed.

[previewyoutube=OXNY0MFGd1E;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]










[list]
[*]Soul Boom: hitbox shortened by 1
[*]Guardian's Mace: hitbox increased by 1
[*]Infernal Fury: hitbox decreased by 1
[*]The areas before the bosses will now have a fog, and you have to interact to enter.
[*]Damage reduction caused by poisonous puddles.
[*]Judged's Earring accessory now completely negates damage from poisonous puddles.
[*]Increased the resistance of the damage caused by the terrain of the armor: Executioner Mantle.
[*]Various changes in the environment.
[/list]

This update is not present in the Demo version.
Thanks to everyone, and have fun everyone.

notes.title: Gem Fix patch
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
Balances were made within the game, which led to the change in enchantments and the number of slots on the equipment.

[list]

[*]Emerald, Crystal and Sapphire now increase the Focus stat.

[*]Danmat's Horn, Dragon Scales, and Demon Tooth now increase maximum LPs.

[*]Ancient Page and Old Seal now increase maximum APs.
[/list]
Thanks for your attention, enjoy everyone!

notes.title: New menu update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
We are happy to announce a new update that will improve the gaming experience.
The equipment menu now shows only useful stats: Life points, Arcane Points, Strength, Arcane, Agility, Accuracy, Evasion, Critical, Stamina Regeneration.
In addition, some balances have been made on armor and weapons.

Change:

[list]
[*]Eliminated Focus and Spirit stats in various armor.
[*]Eliminate the Focus stat in the El legendaria el Bastardos weapon.
[*]The EX-Parameters are visible in the equipment menu.
[*]Added in the Dream armor set up + 7% critical total.
[*]Changed the Ring of Spirit to the Alchemist's Ring which adds + 10% potency to potions.[/list]


Have fun, we're preparing high end dungeons!

notes.title: New Dungeon Update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!ːsteamhappyː
I am happy to announce that the new Dungeon accessible in the final end game area has been released.
It includes 3 floors with rooms full of dangers and treasures, and a new boss!
In addition to this new content, bugs have been fixed:

[list]
[*]The Armored Soldier will no longer trigger the Hyper Armor to the player

[*]The Thread Staff now uses the correct statistics

[*]Arrangement of the lettering in the menu.
[/list]

We are doing a check up of the game to look for small problems like these and they will be fixed at the next update with the new Doungeon.

Thanks for your attention, enjoy!ːsteammockingː

notes.title: Upgrade Dungeons
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36371491/41550c9908e9bf4b7ab01f068ca1ce4aaf169aef.png[/img]

Hello everyone!

Today the game has been updated to include new content that will be released in the coming months.
Now in the End Game area there is a new unlockable area killing 1265 enemies, obviously after defeating the final boss, where there will be new Doungeons to explore with new enemies and Bosses.

In addition to this addition, several small problems have been fixed:

[list]
[*] Special Arcane Weapons: Special ranged attack now deals damage to enemies.

[*] Fixing typing errors in the menu.

[/list]
Have fun!
